create_braintrust_logger: create a BraintrustLogger instance with an API key to log LLM events to Braintrust
log_success_event: log a successful LLM completion event to Braintrust with input, output, and token metrics
async_log_success_event: log a successful LLM completion event asynchronously to Braintrust with input, output, and token metrics
log_failure_event: log a failed LLM event to Braintrust with error details from kwargs and response object
get_project_id_sync: get a Braintrust project ID by name using a synchronous HTTP call with caching
